entries.label: Arctis
cells: This character is always active within the Lab Mainframe. However, they will not gain any Lab EXP! Minor bonus for a linked character, at most: +15 Talent LV for all talents above Lv 1. Blessing: +3% Divinity PTS Gain.

entries.label: Bagur
cells: I am not yet prepared to bestow upon you my bonus, give me some time. You may link with me, but nothing will come of it. Minor bonus: Nothing. Be patient mortal. Blessing: +5% Sailing Speed.

entries.label: Flutterbis
cells: Whenever you level up a skill thats over Lv 50, a Divinity Pearl will drop which gives +40% exp to any skill under Lv 50! Minor bonus for a linked character, at most: +150% skill exp. Blessing: +1% Total Damage.

entries.label: Goharut
cells: Being connected to the Lab also counts as being present at the Divinity Altar, so you get gains for both! Minor bonus for a linked character, at most: +5% AFK Gains for ALL characters! Blessing: +4% Sailing Speed.

entries.label: Harriep
cells: This character produces 3x more resources at 3d Printer! Works with the Lab Bonus, but won't affect the displayed printer amount. Minor bonus for a linked character, at most: +100% coins gained for ALL characters! Blessing: +3% Divinity PTS Gain.

entries.label: Kattlekruk
cells: Every day you play, you get +20 LV for some Alchemy Bubbles. Only 1 player can link here. Minor bonus for a linked character, at most: +10% chance for 2x Statue Drops, for ALL characters! Blessing: +1% Total Damage.

entries.label: Nobisect
cells: All kills count for 2x more kills for opening portals and accumulating Deathnote kills. Minor bonus for a linked character, at most: +200% Total Damage. Blessing: +50 All Skill Efficiency.

entries.label: Omniphau
cells: When claiming non-candy AFK gains, also progress one of the following by the AFK time! (Refinery, 3D Printer, Cooking, Mob Breeding, Sailing, or Gaming) Minor bonus for a linked character, at most: +100% Class EXP. Blessing: +4% Divinity PTS Gain.

entries.label: Purrmep
cells: All characters produce 2x more Divinity, and get 2x more Divinity EXP! Only 1 player can link to Purrmep. Minor bonus for a linked character, at most: +50% Boat Sailing speed and +50% Gaming Plant grow speed. Blessing: +3% Sailing Speed.

entries.label: Snehebatu
cells: +30% AFK Gains for all activities! Minor bonus for a linked character, at most: +70% accuracy and +70% defence. Blessing: +2% Divinity PTS Gain.

pageProps.seoDescription: Every one of the 10 divinity gods in Legends of Idleon, and what each one connects to.
